description: EU CBAM (Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism, Reg. (EU) 2023/956) certificate and cost estimate for up to 20 import lines (CN code, country of origin, tonnes, import date) using the official default values (2025/2621 as corrected), benchmarks (2025/2620), mark-up, CBAM factor and the Commission's quarterly certificate price, with optional production route and carbon price paid; or list the quarterly certificate prices. Electricity is not covered; a quarter's price that is not yet published (2026-Q4) is an estimate. Provided by Atlas Data (third-party seller); cached up to 24 h. © European Union, Decision 2011/833/EU. Not legal or tax advice; not legally binding. Price 0.03 USD per call via x402.

carbonPricePaidEurPerTco2e.description: Simplified Art. 9 deduction: effective carbon price paid in the country of origin

certificatePriceEur.description: Your own price per certificate instead of the official quarterly price

country.description: Default country of origin for lines without one (empty = 'Other countries and territories' default values)

importDate.description: Default import date: sets reporting year (mark-up, CBAM factor) and quarterly price; default today (UTC)

lines.description: Up to 20 lines 'CN/TARIC code|country of origin|net tonnes|importDate' separated by ',' or ';', e.g. 7208 51 20|TR|100|2026-08-15

maxItems.description: Max rows (default all lines; clamped to 20)

mode.description: calculate (default) = certificates and cost per import line; listPrices = quarterly certificate prices, CBAM factor and CSCF

productionRoute.description: Benchmark production route for the free-allocation adjustment (normally from the default-value table)

name: cbam_calc
